content:
In the paper by Moshe Yarom:the lexicographic kernel of a cooperative game in the abstract it is stated on the last line: kernel is a geometrical locus in the non-empty ϵ\epsilonϵ-core, whereas nucleolus is not.

I do not follow this statement along with the notion a "geometrical locus".

I.e. I'm looking for an explanation of the statement together with the definition a geometrical locus of the non-empty ϵ\epsilonϵ-core.
